inventory.rationale: Email signup strip on 20 pages (email input + reCAPTCHA, posts to the marketing backend) → custom newsletter form block + submission integration.

Calf milk-replacer mixing calculator: feeding frequency, weight/age radios, calf count → computed volume, powder kg/bags and water (agbizCalculator). Bespoke calculation logic — custom block.
32-field quote request (customer details, product selects with quantities, region, reCAPTCHA) → custom form block + backend integration.
23-field farmer sign-up form (contact details, farm type/size selects, reCAPTCHA) → custom form block + CRM integration.
